id.description: The criterion id exactly as it appears in the rubric.

rationale.description: Why this score, in one or two sentences.
rationale.title: Rationale

evidence.description: Quotes or timestamped observations supporting the score.

timestamp.description: Where in the video, as mm:ss or hh:mm:ss.

observation.description: What was said or done at that point.

description: Structured output the model returns for a single video submission. Generated from hr_agents/models.py by scripts/generate_schema.py — do not edit by hand. The model scores criteria; hr_agents/scoring.py computes the weighted total and applies the pass threshold.

confidence.description: Confidence in this scoring. Lower it for poor audio, a partial recording, or a rubric that does not fit what was submitted.
confidence.title: Confidence

confidence_reason.description: Why confidence is at that level.
confidence_reason.title: Confidence Reason

summary.description: Two or three sentences an applicant could read.
summary.title: Summary

flags.description: Conditions requiring human attention regardless of score.
